description: This file defines the Html utility class within Drupal, providing helper methods for parsing, serializing, and manipulating HTML strings and DOM documents, including URL transformations, ID and class sanitization, and handling of HTML entities.

classes.name: Html
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods for HTML parsing, serialization, URL handling, and ID/class sanitization within Drupal.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Prepares a string for use as a valid CSS class name, caching cleaned class names.

methods.name: cleanCssIdentifier
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be a valid CSS identifier, with optional character replacements.

methods.name: setIsAjax
methods.description: Sets whether the current request is an AJAX request.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Generates a unique HTML ID, appending counters or random strings for AJAX requests.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be a valid HTML ID without ensuring uniqueness.

methods.name: resetSeenIds
methods.description: Resets the internal cache of seen IDs.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes an HTML string by parsing and serializing it.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Parses an HTML snippet into a DOMDocument using the HTML5 parser.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the body of a DOMDocument back into an HTML string.

methods.name: escapeCdataElement
methods.description: Wraps CDATA sections in comments to prevent HTML parsing issues.

methods.name: decodeEntities
methods.description: Decodes all HTML entities in a string to UTF-8 characters.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string to HTML entities.

methods.name: transformRootRelativeUrlsToAbsolute
methods.description: Converts root-relative URLs in HTML to absolute URLs based on a given scheme and host.
